$comment: Forge execution pool size. Per-host sizes are operator-private and live in the operator layer (forgeSlots.hosts in the operator platform-preferences file, read through policy-cascade); a flat Forge deployment may instead place its own forge-slots.json beside forge-slots.mjs. FORGE_EXEC_SLOTS overrides these settings (integer 1..128); FORGE_HOST overrides hostname discovery. Lower settings never retire installed slots; inspect reservations before any manual retirement.
